Do I need to set anything up?
No. Install Semafor and it starts checking orders right away. Checkout blocking, device recognition and the pop-up are switched on automatically — no code, no theme edits.
No. They simply see no payment method (or no cash on delivery), depending on the rule you chose. There is no message saying they were blocked.
The store network only exchanges anonymous fingerprints, never names or addresses. Every e-mail has a one-click unsubscribe, and Shopify's data requests and deletions are handled automatically.
Do I need an e-mail service?
No. Reminder and welcome e-mails are sent by Semafor and included in your plan. If you prefer, connect your own domain with a step-by-step guide.
The app is available in English, Romanian, Spanish, French, Polish and Russian. E-mails and the pop-up follow your customer's language.
What happens after the free trial?
Your store moves to the Free plan and keeps checking 50 orders a month. Your settings are saved — choose a plan any time to switch everything back on.
